description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

You take a single Action to wolf down a portable ration as fuel. For 1 minute (10 rounds in encounter mode), your melee Strikes deal +1 status damage; if you have any expansion technique active (such as Bubun Baika), increase the bonus to +2.
